body:
- **Tailwind utilities first.** `.fv-*` classes reserved for
  rendered content that external libs own (react-markdown body, json
  viewer).
- **shadcn tokens only** — `bg-muted`, `text-foreground`, `border`,
  etc. No raw `bg-gray-900`.
- **Dark mode via `[data-theme="dark"]` attribute** on `<html>` using
  `@custom-variant dark (&:is([data-theme="dark"], [data-theme="dark"] *))`
  — not a `.dark` class.
- **Package-local styles** stay in the package (Tailwind classes on
  JSX). Don't hoist into the host stylesheet.
- **Tailwind v4 needs explicit `@source`** to scan workspace pkgs.
  `apps/chrome-ext/src/styles/index.css` has:
  `@source "../../../../packages/*/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}"`. Without
  this, pkg-local utility classes silently vanish from the final CSS.
